_comment: Normative constants for the RoboTensor one-demonstration in-context imitation learning competition. The validator and the dashboard both read this file; nothing in it may be duplicated as a literal in code. spec_fingerprint = sha256 of the canonical JSON of this file. Changing spec_version changes every derived duel_id and therefore every draw; bump it only deliberately. Version 2 replaced the four perturbation axes with skills: every skill is scored as one success rate and the final score is the mean over skills. Version 3 removed the organizer perturbation groups: a unit is one task, one of its initial states, one prompt demonstration and a seed, exactly as BPP's own runner evaluates.

track.title: One-demo in-context imitation
track._comment: The model is shown exactly one demonstration of the task and no language. The demonstration is the whole prompt.

pick_and_place.title: Pick and place
pick_and_place.blurb: Grasp one object and place it at a destination, as BPP's LIBERO pick-and-place domain defines it: one grasp stage followed by one place stage. Every unit starts from one of the task's benchmark initial states; the demonstration is another episode of the same task and never starts from the scored state.

task_filter._comment: A task belongs to the skill iff its goal is a single On/In predicate and its language names no open/close/turn-on/push stage - BPP's Grasp then Place, nothing else.

draw_anything.title: Draw anything
draw_anything.blurb: Reproduce a drawing shown once. The demonstration is a human drawing the shape on a square whiteboard; the model draws it again on a board turned to a random angle, with the pen starting at a random place, as BPP's DrawAnything-Sim domain evaluates it.

environment._comment: DrawAnything-Sim as BPP evaluates it: a 512 px canvas with a 350 px square board, 10 Hz position control of a pen (x, y, pen_down), one 224 px observation, prompts chunked every 10 actions with the trailing partial chunk dropped. A unit's board angle is uniform in board_angle_range_rad and its pen start uniform in cursor_start_range_px, the ranges DrawEnv samples from; both are derived from the task id and instance index. An episode also ends when the pen has not moved idle_stop_px for idle_stop_steps steps, as in BPP's runner.

success._comment: A unit succeeds iff the lowest symmetric Chamfer distance, in canvas pixels, between the demonstrated strokes and the drawn strokes at any step of the episode is at most threshold (the pen is 12 px wide). Calibrated on 80 units drawn from pool 2026.09-v2 with the genesis checkpoint: best-Chamfer percentiles 10/25/50/75/90 = 0.96/1.39/2.46/3.83/7.21 px; the baseline succeeds on 0.79 of the units at 4 px, its misses being the long multi-part drawings. See docs/pools.md.

pools._comment: pool_id is filled by `icilval pools build` (or `pools upgrade`) and must equal pool.json's id; the validator refuses to run on a mismatch. init_states_per_task also sizes the draw skill's table of (board angle, cursor start) instances. The pinned id is the v2 pool until the spec v3 pool is built and pinned at the end of the milestone.

duel._crown_comment: Both sides run the identical unit list (same tasks, initial states, prompt demonstrations and seeds). Per-skill success rate is stored as a fraction in [0, 1]; the final score is the mean over skills. A skill's units are spread evenly over its eligible tasks. The challenger takes the crown iff challenger.average >= king.average + score_margin / 100. Paired per-unit outcomes are published as a diagnostic and never decide the crown.
duel._max_steps_comment: skills.<skill>.max_steps are per-skill caps; each task carries its own (smaller) limit from its source benchmark.

model._comment: A submission is a Hugging Face model repo holding one directory per skill, each with model.safetensors and config.yaml. For every skill the validator instantiates the architecture from its own allow-listed template (arch/<architecture>.cfg.json), diffs the submitted config against it, checks the safetensors header against arch/<architecture>.tensors.json, and loads weights strictly. No pickle is ever read and no entrant code runs. max_params applies per skill; max_repo_bytes to the whole repo.
model._mutable_comment: Dotted paths under `model` that may differ from the template without affecting inference. Training-only keys are overwritten by the converter, so they never differ.

baseline.label: BPP public checkpoints (austinpatel/libero and austinpatel/drawanything_sim, converted)
baseline._comment: The genesis king: one repo holding both converted public checkpoints, one directory per skill.

media._comment: resolution and camera describe LIBERO clips; draw clips are the board render at skills.draw_anything.environment.render_resolution and draw demonstration clips are the 224 px observation frames.

store._layout_comment: manifest.json; tracks/{track}/{head.json,queue.json,index-NNNN.jsonl}; events/{track}/{event_id}.json; media/{sha[:2]}/{sha}.mp4. Index lines are '<canonical_json>\t<ed25519_signature_hex>', append-only.
